title: Inside a Dinosaur's Egg
content: Here's my best guess about what's inside a dinosaur egg, halfway through incubation.The painting is done with oil paint, thinned with solvent and Liquin on illustration board that's been sealed with acrylic matte medium.The image is fromDinotopia: A Land Apart from Time.It also appears in my workshop on "maps and cutaway views" for the fantasy artist in thecurrent issue of ImagineFX magazine.
